name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NativeHop.gsw_path_product
title: GSW path products: a witness-selected chain of G^{-1}-products of ciphertexts A R_i + x_i G is A R' + (product of the x_i) G
statement: Over a commutative ring, with G * Ginv Y = Y for all Y, the right-nested product (A R_1 + x_1 G) Ginv((A R_2 + x_2 G) Ginv(... (A R_0 + x_0 G))) equals A R' + (x_1 ... x_L x_0) G for some R'.
